text: …　なにが　つれるかって？

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と and repeats back what someone just said or asked. なにが　つれるかって = 'what can you catch, you ask?'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing つる to つれる turns 'to fish' into 'can be caught by fishing'. なにが　つれる = 'what can be caught'.
